test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana, which of the following is NOT the correct eligibility?

options.text: Should be belonging to Madhya Pradesh
Candidates can be married, widowed or divorced women
Annual family income should be below ₹4.50 Lakh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Annual family income should be below ₹4.50 Lakh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana:-**

 
 
• **It is a scheme launched by the Madhya Pradesh government to economically empower women. **
 
• Under this scheme, a sum of ₹1,000 per month is provided to women of the state above the age of 21, irrespective of their caste, religion or community.
 
• **The scheme was launched on March 5, 2023, and a provision of ₹1,000 crore has been made for it in the 2023-24 budget.**
 
• The eligibility criteria for the beneficiaries of the Ladli Behna Yojana are as follows:
 
 
• **The applicant must be above 21 years of age.**
 
• The applicant must belong to any caste, religion or community.
 
• **Candidates can be married, widowed or divorced women.**
 
• The applicant must have a bank account.
 
• The applicant must have an Aadhaar card and other necessary documents.
